description: Roadmap y Timeline integrados de Crestone

features.title: OData in the app
features.description: More robust attachments, connections, and navigation. Attachments and their target destination can now be configured directly within **OData**, along with improved URL readability and greater stability in connections, endpoint validation, and pagination.

features.title: General improvements
features.description: A more consistent end-to-end flow. The complete OData extraction flow with attachments was optimized, with internal adjustments to ensure stronger consistency across configuration, execution, and final destination.

features.title: End-to-end attachments and better performance
features.description: The full attachments extraction flow has been implemented, enabling direct delivery to the configured destination, along with automatic generation of a metadata file for traceability. In addition, parallel processing was optimized (default 20 threads) to improve execution times.

features.title: SQL as a source
features.description: Enable SQL Server as a data source to extract tables/views, with support for full and (when applicable) incremental loads, plus flexible connection and query configuration.

features.title: Job execution triggers
features.description: Provide a mechanism to automatically trigger jobs based on events/conditions (e.g., completion of a previous job, data availability, external signal, or schedule), reducing manual execution and improving orchestration.

features.title: HANA as a Destination
features.description: Load extracted data into SAP HANA, with support for full and, where applicable, incremental loads, along with flexible connection and write configuration options.

features.title: SSO in Crestone for Microsoft
features.description: Enable Single Sign-On with Microsoft accounts, allowing users to access Crestone securely and seamlessly while simplifying authentication and user management.

features.title: Licensing control
features.description: Implementation of a centralized interface for proactive management of the license lifecycle, including expiration alerts and usage tracking to avoid surprises at contract end.

features.title: PostgreSQL Integration
features.description: Enable optimized connection and data extraction with PostgreSQL databases to expand the sources of information supported by the platform.

features.title: Oracle Integration
features.description: Deep and optimized integration for efficient data extraction and processing to Oracle databases.

features.title: Sybase Integration
features.description: Integration of a dedicated connector for Sybase databases, expanding the ecosystem of legacy and critical databases supported by the platform.

features.title: MySQL Integration
features.description: Enable MySQL as a destination in Crestone, allowing customers to load extracted data into MySQL databases and support operational or application-based data scenarios.

features.title: IBM Integration
features.description: Enable IBM databases such as DB2 or Informix as data sources, ensuring compatibility with large corporate and mission-critical environments.

features.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Integration
features.description: Enable Microsoft Dynamics 365 as a destination, allowing Crestone to deliver data into business applications that support sales, service and customer processes.

features.title: AWS Storage Integration
features.description: Enable AWS Storage as a data source, allowing Crestone to read files and datasets from AWS-based storage environments and include them in integration workflows.

features.title: Azure Storage Integration
features.description: Enable Azure Storage as a data source, helping customers extract information from Microsoft cloud storage environments with a guided and consistent configuration experience.

features.title: Google Cloud Platform Integration
features.description: Enable Google Cloud Platform as a data source, expanding Crestone’s reach into Google cloud environments and supporting broader cloud-based data integration scenarios.

features.title: Salesforce Integration
features.description: We will establish a deep integration to synchronize key data from Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Marketing Cloud.

features.title: Integrations SAP BW
features.description: Implementation of an advanced connection with SAP BW for efficient data extraction from InfoProviders, DSOs, and Cubes, consolidating BI analytical capabilities.

features.title: SAP Business Data Cloud Integration
features.description: Enable SAP Business Data Cloud as both a source and a destination, allowing Crestone to exchange data with SAP’s business data layer and support more flexible analytics scenarios.

features.title: Crestone available on Microsoft Azure Marketplace
features.description: Make Crestone available through Microsoft Azure Marketplace, simplifying access and adoption for organizations already operating within the Microsoft cloud ecosystem.

features.title: AI assistant
features.description: Ease of use one of the pillars of the product is enhanced with the incorporation of artificial intelligence, which assists you in configuration, monitoring, and resolving operational tasks, reducing time and errors.

features.title: ACT·in powered by Crestone (standard extraction layer)
features.description: act·in solutions will use Crestone as the underlying engine for data extractions and delivery, standardizing connectivity and scheduling while improving reliability and traceability end-to-end.

features.title: SAP Concur Integration
features.description: Enable SAP Concur as a data source, allowing Crestone to extract travel, expense and related business information into data integration workflows.

features.title: Real time connection
features.description: In addition to traditional transfer scheduling, the ability to operate in real time is added, thus completing a flexible palette of options that adapts to different business scenarios and data volumes.

features.title: Amazon Redshift Integration
features.description: Enable Amazon Redshift as a data source, helping customers extract analytical data from AWS data warehouse environments into Crestone workflows.

features.title: Snowflake Integration
features.description: Enable Snowflake as a data source, allowing customers to extract data from one of the most widely used cloud data platforms.

features.title: Teradata Integration
features.description: Enable Teradata as a data source, supporting extraction from enterprise data warehouse environments commonly used in large organizations.

features.title: Databricks Integration
features.description: Enable Databricks as a data source, allowing Crestone to connect with advanced analytics and data engineering environments.

features.title: Google Cloud BigQuery Integration
features.description: Enable Google BigQuery as a data source, allowing customers to extract analytical data from Google Cloud’s data warehouse platform.

features.title: Microsoft Fabric Integration
features.description: Enable Microsoft Fabric as a data source, helping customers connect data from Microsoft’s analytics ecosystem into Crestone workflows.

features.title: Query Designer
features.description: Incorporation of a visual environment for query design, simplifying the creation and validation of extraction rules without the need for advanced technical knowledge, optimizing user experience and result accuracy.

features.title: Data Preservation Module
features.description: Add a data preservation module within Crestone to retain historical information, supporting traceability, continuity and access to prior data states when needed.

features.title: Crestone available on Snowflake Marketplace
features.description: Crestone will be available for customers to obtain directly from Snowflake Marketplace, simplifying access and purchasing within the Snowflake ecosystem and improving product discoverability.

features.title: Cloudera Integration
features.description: Native and optimized integration with the Cloudera ecosystem for the extraction, processing, and management of large volumes of data, facilitating Big Data analysis.

features.title: ETL capabilities
features.description: Extend Crestone from extraction to an end-to-end ETL platform by adding built-in transformations and orchestration, enabling data cleansing and standardization before delivery to the target system and reducing reliance on external tools.

features.title: Crestone available on Google Cloud
features.description: Enable Crestone deployment on Google Cloud, allowing customers to accelerate implementation without changing their cloud strategy and standardize their data operations in GCP.

features.title: Crestone available on AWS
features.description: Enable Crestone deployment on AWS, allowing customers to adopt the platform within their preferred cloud ecosystem while maintaining greater control over data and operations.

features.title: Crestone available on Databricks Marketplace
features.description: Crestone will be available for customers to obtain directly from Databricks Marketplace, simplifying access and purchasing within the Databricks ecosystem and improving product discoverability.
